type.description: The type of license. Choices are: 'producer', 'broker'.

subdivision.description: The state or province of the license. Format is the two-letter abbreviation.

licenseStatus.description: The status of the license. Choices are: 'active', 'inactive', 'cancelled'.

residentStatus.description: The resident status of the license. Choices are: 'resident', 'non-resident'.

expirationDate.description: The expiration date of the license. Format is 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

agency.description: The unique ID of the agency that this license is scoped to.

agencyLicensee.description: The unique ID of the agency that is the licensee.

agentLicensee.description: The unique ID of the agent that is the licensee.

agentsGrantedAccess.description: An array of unique IDs of agents that have been granted access to the license.
